1.text: O you who covers himself [with a garment],<sup foot_note="228116">1</sup>

footnotes.228117: - Specifically, idols or generally, bad conduct and morals.

6.text: And do not confer favor to acquire more<sup foot_note="228118">1</sup>

footnotes.228118: - An alternative meaning is "Do not consider any favor you have conferred to be great."

7.text: But for your Lord be patient.

8.text: And when the trumpet is blown,

9.text: That Day will be a difficult day

11.text: Leave Me with the one I created alone<sup foot_note="228119">1</sup>

footnotes.228119: - i.e., without wealth or children.  The reference is to al-Waleed bin al-Mugheerah, who after inclining toward the Qur’ān, denied it publicly in order to win the approval of the Quraysh.

12.text: And to whom I granted extensive wealth

14.text: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].

15.text: Then he desires that I should add more.

16.text: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.

17.text: I will cover him with arduous torment.

18.text: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.<sup foot_note="228120">1</sup>

footnotes.228120: - About what he would say concerning the Qur’ān and how he might discredit the Prophet (ﷺ).

19.text: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

20.text: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

23.text: Then he turned back and was arrogant

24.text: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].

25.text: This is not but the word of a human being."

26.text: I will drive him into Saqar.<sup foot_note="228121">1</sup>

footnotes.228121: - One of the proper names of Hell.

27.text: And what can make you know what is Saqar?

28.text: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],

31.text: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allāh intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allāh send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.

33.text: And [by] the night when it departs

34.text: And [by] the morning when it brightens,

35.text: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions]

37.text: To whoever wills among you to proceed<sup foot_note="228122">1</sup> or stay behind.

footnotes.228122: - To righteousness by acceptance of the warning.

38.text: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained<sup foot_note="228123">1</sup>

39.text: Except the companions of the right,<sup foot_note="228124">1</sup>.

footnotes.228124: - i.e., the righteous who receive their records in their right hands.

40.text: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other

42.text: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"

43.text: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,

44.text: Nor did we used to feed the poor.

45.text: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],

46.text: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense

47.text: Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."

48.text: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.

49.text: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away

50.text: As if they were alarmed donkeys

52.text: Rather, every person among them desires that he<sup foot_note="228125">1</sup> would be given scriptures spread about.<sup foot_note="228126">2</sup>

footnotes.228126: i.e., made public.  Much of their refusal of his message was due to envy and jealousy of the Prophet (ﷺ).

53.text: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.

54.text: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder

55.text: Then whoever wills will remember it.

56.text: And they will not remember except that Allāh wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
